name: CPU & cooling
author: juansebas7ian
description: Live CPU temperature in the bar; graphs of CPU temperature, load and cooler speed; per-thread load and clock; AIO pump and fans; all temperatures. Warns when the CPU reaches 90 °C or the pump stops.

barWidget.description: Left = panel · right = btop. Red at 90 °C or when the AIO pump stops (also a notification).
